questions.text: Prepare a report of a case study of a cybersecurity breach and its consequences. Write abstract, finding and discussion parts only.
You are the project leader for a team of 20 members. As the team members are not submitting the weekly time sheets regularly, write an e-mail to them stressing the need to submit without fail.

questions.text: Create a bar graph (Gantt chart) to show the work schedule of any proposed technical project.
Prepare a reference page of the given publication details according to the APA (American Psychological Association) style of citation.
Define technical communication, and mention its scope and importance for engineers.
Describe the nature of technical communication and mention core ethics of engineering profession.

Write bias-free (gender-neutral) words of the following: Career girl, mailman, freshman, front man, working woman, workmanship, masterplan, motherly, brotherhood, manhood, waitress, foreman, alumni, faculty wife, Frenchmen, gentleman's agreement.
What are the tips to make any technical writing coherent and concise? Does avoiding redundancy lead to concise writing?

Every year a huge number of Nepalese lose their lives in road accidents. To minimize the loss of lives you want to do a study. Write a brief proposal to an organization incorporating title page, abstract and introduction parts.

Prepare a proposal for construction of a public library building in your local town to be submitted to the Mayor of the concerned municipality. Show only the title page, abstract and cost estimate sections of the proposal.

As a Personnel Manager of Dynamics Tools Manufacturing Co. Ltd, Teku, Kathmandu, you have been deputed to investigate the causes of frequent strikes in the company's factory at Ring Road and to suggest preventive measures. Write only cover page, preface, and recommendations parts of your report.
Write a job application for the post of an IT officer in XYZ Software Company, Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Also, create a resume to be attached with it.

Prepare a complaint letter to be sent to the head office of your organization's internet service provider and express your dissatisfaction of poor internet connection despite using their most premium package.
As a secretary of your local social club, write a notice with four-point agenda for the third monthly meeting of the club. Base the agenda on the upcoming election of the club.
Write a short note on barriers of active listening and how to overcome them.
What do you mean by non-verbal communication? Describe its elements in brief.

Write a formal Project Proposal for establishing a high-speed campus-wide Wi-Fi network or solar power backup system for your engineering institute. Include Title, Executive Summary, Problem Statement, Objectives, Methodology, Work Plan (Gantt Chart), Budget Estimate, and Deliverables.
questions.solutionOutline: Comprehensive technical proposal with standard academic sections. Executive summary highlights business need, total cost, and ROI. Technical specification covers access points, fiber backbone, core switch topology, PoE switches, authentication server, Gantt milestones across 6 months, itemized budget in NRs, and maintenance warranty.

questions.text: Write a comprehensive Technical Report on a Feasibility Study for constructing an electric vehicle charging network or automated smart traffic monitoring system. Structure with Title Page, Abstract, Table of Contents, Introduction, Technical Findings, Cost Analysis, Conclusion, and Recommendations.
questions.solutionOutline: Formal engineering report. Title, abstract, table of contents. Introduction details project scope and urban traffic context. Technical section details DC fast chargers, transformer capacity, grid synchronization, IoT payment gateways, financial benefit-cost analysis, environmental impact, conclusions, and concrete actionable recommendations.

questions.text: Draft a Formal Letter of Application (Cover Letter) and a Professional Curriculum Vitae (CV) applying for the position of Assistant Engineer at a multinational technology corporation.
questions.solutionOutline: Cover letter follows standard formal business layout: sender address, date, inside address, subject line, professional salutation, three-paragraph body (opening statement of application, core engineering qualifications and accomplishments, closing call to interview), and complimentary close. CV organizes Contact Details, Career Objective, Education, Technical Skills, Projects, and References.

questions.text: Draft an official Tender Notice and Quotation Request for supplying 100 enterprise server machines and laboratory networking equipment. Specify procurement terms, bid submission deadline, bid security, and eligibility criteria.
questions.solutionOutline: Public procurement notice formatted with Notice Number, Date, Project Name, Scope of Supply, Technical Specifications, Eligibility (VAT registration, tax clearance, manufacturer authorization), Bid Security (2.5% of estimate), Document Fee, Submission Deadline, Bid Opening time, and Right to Accept/Reject clause.

questions.text: Draft a formal Notice, Agenda, and Minutes of a Board of Directors / Project Review Meeting discussing project milestones, cost overruns, and corrective action plans.
questions.solutionOutline: Meeting notice includes Date, Time, Venue, and Agenda items. Minutes record Name of Organization, Meeting Number, Attendance list, Chairperson remarks, Agenda-by-Agenda discussion, formal Resolutions passed (Resolution No., Proposed by, Seconded by, Decision), and Signatures of Secretary and Chairperson.

questions.text: Draft a formal Business Memorandum (Memo) to all department staff communicating strict data protection protocols and new enterprise password rotation policies.
questions.solutionOutline: Memo format: TO, FROM, DATE, SUBJECT. Body communicates policy reason concisely, specifies concrete requirements (minimum 12 characters, complexity, 90-day rotation, MFA enablement), deadline for compliance, and IT Helpdesk contact for assistance.

questions.text: Explain the Communication Process Model: Sender, Encoding, Message, Channel, Receiver, Decoding, Feedback, and Noise. Describe Psychological, Physical, Semantic, and Organizational barriers to effective technical communication.
questions.solutionOutline: Communication is two-way dynamic process. Shannon-Weaver and Berlo SMCR models. Barriers: Physical (distance, background noise), Semantic (jargon, ambiguous words), Psychological (prejudice, cognitive bias, emotional state), Organizational (hierarchical bureaucracy, rigid filtering). Feedback closes loop verifying mutual understanding.

questions.text: Explain the 7 C's of Effective Communication (Clear, Concise, Concrete, Correct, Coherent, Complete, Courteous) with practical engineering correspondence examples.
questions.solutionOutline: Clear (unambiguous purpose), Concise (eliminate wordiness), Concrete (use specific facts and numbers instead of vague statements), Correct (accurate grammar, figures, technical facts), Coherent (logical progression of ideas), Complete (all necessary information included), Courteous (polite, respectful tone emphasizing reader perspective).

questions.text: Write an informative user manual / technical description with step-by-step operating instructions and safety precautions for an engineering laboratory instrument (e.g., Digital Storage Oscilloscope or Total Station).
questions.solutionOutline: Technical manual: Title, Overview, Equipment Specifications, Labeled Diagram, Step-by-Step Operating Procedures (initial setup, calibration, measurement sequence, data acquisition), Precautionary Warnings (danger/caution notices), and Basic Troubleshooting table.

questions.text: Explain Effective Presentation Skills. Discuss Audience Analysis, structuring the Introduction, Body, and Conclusion, handling Q&A sessions, and managing speech anxiety.
questions.solutionOutline: Audience analysis adapts technical depth to listener expertise. Introduction grabs attention, states thesis, outlines roadmap. Body uses 3-4 structured main points supported by visual evidence. Conclusion summarizes takeaways with strong call to action. Q&A: active listening, rephrasing questions, concise answers. Speech anxiety managed through preparation, visualization, and controlled breathing.

questions.text: Explain Group Discussion (GD) and Job Interview techniques. Discuss body language, active listening, articulation of viewpoints, leadership traits, and common pitfalls during interview interactions.
questions.solutionOutline: GD evaluates interpersonal skills, reasoning, team cooperation, and communication. Effective tactics: initiating discussion constructively, facilitating turn-taking, acknowledging others' points, mediating disputes. Interview strategies: STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for behavioral questions, maintaining confident eye contact, open posture, professional attire, avoiding arrogance.

questions.chapter: Use of Visual Aids in Communication
questions.text: Discuss the Effective Use of Visual Aids in Technical Communication. Compare Tables, Bar Charts, Pie Charts, Line Graphs, and Infographics in presenting experimental engineering data.
questions.solutionOutline: Visual aids enhance retention, clarify complex data, and emphasize trends. Tables present exact numerical values. Line graphs display continuous trends and rates of change over time. Bar charts compare discrete categorical quantities. Pie charts depict proportional shares of a whole (under 7 slices). Design rules: descriptive title, clear axis labels with units, consistent scale, and citing data source.

questions.text: Write a precis (summary) of a given technical passage reducing it to one-third of its original length. Provide a suitable title and state the essential thesis statement.
questions.solutionOutline: Precis rules: 1) Express main idea in own words without editorializing; 2) Maintain original author viewpoint in third person past tense; 3) Omit illustrations, examples, repetitions, and digressions; 4) Restrict length to exactly one-third of original word count; 5) Assign crisp relevant title and provide final word count.

questions.text: Explain principles of Paragraph Writing: Topic Sentence, Unity, Coherence, Transitional devices, and Methods of Development (Cause & Effect, Comparison & Contrast, Chronological).
questions.solutionOutline: Unified paragraph discusses single central theme stated in topic sentence. Coherence creates smooth flow through logical ordering and transitional words (furthermore, conversely, consequently). Methods of development: Exemplification, Comparison & Contrast, Cause & Effect, Process Description. Concluding sentence summarizes or bridges to next paragraph.
